aboutGame.title: What is Little Crossroads?
paragraphs: Little Crossroads is a cozy multiplayer sandbox RPG developed by Red Merle Games. Set in a tranquil, interconnected realm, players awaken at their own signpost sanctuary to build a personal home, master peaceful gathering skills, and explore diverse biomes at their own relaxed pace.

Cultivate crops on the go with helpful companions like the Grolem dirt golem, link worlds with friends through magical signposts, and customize your character with countless cozy outfits. Our wiki provides complete guides, item catalogs, and progression tips for your adventure.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Little Crossroads.

items.question: What is Little Crossroads?
items.answer: Little Crossroads is a cozy multiplayer sandbox RPG developed by Red Merle Games. Players explore peaceful realms, build custom homes, level up gathering skills, and connect with friends across parallel worlds.

items.question: When is the Little Crossroads release date?
items.answer: The official Little Crossroads release date is targeted for 2027 on PC via Steam, following community playtests and alpha milestones.

items.question: What core skills are available in Little Crossroads?
items.answer: Little Crossroads features five primary gathering skills: Fishing, Bug Catching, Mining, Woodcutting, and Foraging, each unlocking specialized tools and crafting recipes.

items.question: Does Little Crossroads support multiplayer co-op?
items.answer: Yes, Little Crossroads features cross-world online co-op, allowing players to connect realms using magical signposts and explore sanctuaries together.

items.question: What is the Grolem in Little Crossroads?
items.answer: In Little Crossroads, the Grolem is a friendly dirt golem pet companion that functions as a mobile farm, letting you plant and harvest crops anywhere on your journey.
